{{Top|leg}}
'''Drethi''' were winged beasts bred to kill [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The Drethi produced a venom which "burns when [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] flows," making its lethality commensurate with the victim's contact with the Force. The Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Nason Laric]],  fought a Drethi on [[Skalokor]] when facing a group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who had rediscovered the ancient beasts. There was an audible sizzling sound when a Jedi's wounds were touched with Drethi venom. The poison was absolutely lethal to a Jedi unless an antidote made from the venom itself was administered immediately. When a Drethi was killed, it disintegrated into black ash.
